shields_note: Posted 'Shields(10)' outside the 60; all ten are named. They are the Reflections III Dark Defensive Shields (the (Dark) shield pages where an Effect shares the name).
notes: No objective ('Objective (0) NONE'). The strategy says the deck starts the Tatooine system plus Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Mobilization Points and Combat Response (via Prepared Defenses), or Blockade Flagship: Bridge against Watch Your Step; Fear Is My Ally is in the Effects section. All count toward the 60.

The post says the deck placed 1st at FreedomCon (2001 Decipher World Championship, 15–18 November 2001) for Bastian Winkelhaus (5-0) and 2nd for Martin Akesson (4-1, losing only to Winkelhaus in the final), with Akesson's version 4 cards different: DS-181-3 and Saber 3 instead of Major Turr Phennir and Saber 2, a second Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us instead of Keder The Black, and Operational As Planned instead of Masterful Move & Endor Occupation. The idea is credited to Akesson; the title to 'Kim'.

Posted 'Tatooine (old one)' dested the Premiere Tatooine (Dark); 'Tatooine DB', 'Mos Espa DB' and 'Spaceport DB' dested the Dark sites Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (Dark), Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (Dark) and Spaceport Docking Bay (Dark); 'Death Star 2 DB' dested Death Star II: Docking Bay.

Posted 'Omni box % Its worse' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Imperial Artilery' dested Imperial Artillery; 'SFS L-s 9.3 Laser Cannons' dested SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons; 'U-3PO' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio).
